purpose: Teach: 育毛/素顔/投球/真珠/灯油/ゾウ/主食/鯛

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、育毛剤の研究をなさってるんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: I heard one of your regulars does research on hair growth products.
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Soft opening. Speaking slowly as if sharing something she noticed and wanted to mention. Warm curiosity without pressing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、素顔のままお見えになったわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer came in without makeup the other day, didn't they?
lines.style: Light, noticing tone. Matter-of-fact but not judgmental. Slight lift at the end — more observation than question. Conversational, like she's sharing a small detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、投球フォームのお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That regular was talking about their pitching form last time, I think.
lines.style: Soft, recalling tone. Tentative — checking if she remembers correctly. Quiet pace, gentle curiosity. Like she's thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、真珠のネックレスが綺麗ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer has such a beautiful pearl necklace, doesn't she?
lines.style: Warm appreciation in the voice. Genuine compliment, not performative. Slight brightness on 'beautiful.' Noticing detail with affection, like it matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の灯油ストーブ、新しくしたいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The kerosene heater in the shop really could use replacing soon.
lines.style: Thoughtful, practical tone. Quiet observation. Not urgent, but gently suggesting something she's been noticing. Soft trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、ゾウの絵本に夢中だね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That young customer is really absorbed in the elephant picture book.
lines.style: Warm, pleased observation. Gentle smile in the voice. Watching with soft affection, not intrusive. Quiet delight at seeing someone engaged.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お米の主食派なんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: I heard one of your regulars is definitely a rice person, not bread.
lines.style: Light, friendly observation. Slight playfulness — noting a preference. Conversational and warm. Brief, like she's just sharing something she picked up.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、鯛のお祝い料理のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was telling me about this celebration dish they make with sea bream.
lines.style: Warm, interested tone. Recalling something with gentle pleasure. Soft voice, pace unhurried. Trailing-off at the end — lingering on the memory.
